overview: Qualitative study with one-to-one interviews and role-specific focus groups in a coastal town after fluoridation ended, analysed with reflexive thematic analysis.
population: Parents of children under eight (purposively sampled across deprivation quintiles, with at least half from the two most deprived), dentists and dental nurses, school nurses, councillors, and campaigners for and against fluoridation.
exposure: Living or working in the town after fluoridation ended in September 2023.
procedures: Recruitment through children's centres, school nurses, dental practices and both campaign groups. About 24 parent interviews, 10 professional interviews, 6 councillor or campaigner interviews and four focus groups separated by role. Interviews in English or with professional interpreters; vouchers for parents. Topic guide covers knowledge, actions, advice received and trust; anonymised consultation responses (COMMS-2026-08) inform but do not replace interviews.

outcomes.name: Understanding and response of parents
outcomes.measure: Themes on knowledge of the change and actions taken to protect children's teeth

outcomes.name: Trust in the council and in dental advice
Dental team practice after cessation
outcomes.measure: Themes on varnish, advice and access
outcomes.why: Dental teams carry the advice role.

outcomes.name: Reach of the sample
outcomes.measure: Participants by deprivation quintile, language and role
outcomes.why: Checks that the most affected families are heard.

feasibility: About 40 interviews and four focus groups over six months within 6,000 for interpreters, transcription and vouchers.
biasMitigation: Purposive sampling with a quota for the two most deprived quintiles
Separate groups by role and view
Reflexive notes on the team's public health position
A second analyst for a third of transcripts

biasFlags.label: Interviewer seen as partisan
biasFlags.note: Public health staff may be distrusted; interviews are done by a university researcher outside the team.

biasFlags.label: Vocal participants dominating
biasFlags.note: Handled by separate groups and interviews.

biasFlags.label: Stale evidence base
biasFlags.note: The parent survey behind claim c3 was corrected after acceptance; the sampling rationale must be re-checked.

flags: Qualitative study: outcomes are themes, not measures
parsimony.simplestPath: Interviews and role-specific focus groups, one analysis approach.

theoreticalFramework: Trust and legitimacy as sensitising concepts for the topic guide; reflexive thematic analysis.
summary: About 40 interviews and four focus groups, purposively sampled towards the families most affected.
